reviews.review: Best game ever, i've invested over 1500 USD. Took place of a year streak of WoW (getting permabanned by AI didn't help the matters either though.)

Great game in the same genre as Warframe, amazing and communicative dev team, f2p friendly

Definitely worth a try if you enjoy looter shooters

not enough end game content. character balancing is terrible for veteran players who enjoy older descendants.  this game will never compare to warframe if changes aren't made..

As much as i have enjoyed the game for the played time that i had, unfortunately i cant recommend it. The reason is not because as of majority of people, where everybody is upset about recent Ines nerf, Ines is my favourite champion and honesty i did not felt any change there except the increase of skill cooldowns. Regardless of the nerf, i was still enjoying the game.
Now, where it went south?
In short, i am sabotaged by devs that i am not getting any players at all when i queue for public matchmaking. And i have proof for it!


In long, it felt super weird one day to queue for public matchmaking regardless of the content and it allways end up with me being alone in a match. I was testing 400% dungeon, level 30 void errosion, daily missions or even hard void abbyss and yet, i end up playing alone in these public matches. That was when i decided to send a customer support ticket. Since i am a whale, and actually a pretty big one, i knew i was about to get a reply pretty quick, since that is how bussiness is done to keep whales going.
This is what i wrote:
"This is super weird.
I am not getting any players at all in public matchmaking. The excuse of not enough players in game is definitely not a possibility, even errosion 30 i am matched with nobody. For 2 days now.
If i am somehow shadow banned for anything, then i would like to know to improve on whatever it was. If it is related to Results of the crackdown abusive players then i believe i got false positive in this one. I barely talk or interact with anybody in the game."

And that is their response
"Greetings, Descendant!
This is the TFD Support Team.
Thank you for contacting us and we sincerely apologize for the inconvenience that you have been experiencing. Your account has been identified as having an unusual game history and it is being closely investigated.
Please note that your match order will be temporarily reversed while the investigation is ongoing.
If the investigation confirms that you played the game in a legitimate manner, your matching will be normalized. Please note that additional sanctions may be applied if you are found to have played the game in an abnormal manner.
With appreciation,
The First Descendant Team"

Please make it make sense, but i dont see that i am punished for cheating or bad language, and i am pretty confident in that part. I dont know if my opinion about the game will change in the future anymore, because their statement about "temporarily reversed" is totally untrue and the problem still persists. To be honest, i am so glad it happened just before buying the recent 100 dollar Albion Academy Summer Uniform Bundle.

Whoever reads this, make your own decision if you would like to be in the same situation as myself.
Peace and take care!
